name: Spirax Group plc
summary: Spirax Group plc provides thermal energy and fluid technology solutions in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and the Americas. It operates through three segments: Steam Thermal Solutions, Electric Thermal Solutions, and Watson-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions.
